brandComInfo.introduce:
E-Song Digital Limited, established in April 2004, has been a leading solution provider and manufacturer of Video/Audio/IoT/ Tracker with AI algorithm in different applications. We have in-house RD team with industrial design, moulding developping, PCB design, embedded firmware design, APP and back-end managment system development. Our product ranges from body-worn camera, vehicle MDVR, IoT camera/sensors to trackers and other products based on Video/Audio/IoT/Tracker. We are ODM designer and manufacturer of Motorola, Rentokil, Pioneer, HK Government, Museum, ect..



In AI aspects, we have our own Video/Image/Audio Search Engine, to search people, objects, buildings, equipments, speaking from private database or public social medias like Youtube, Facebook, Instagram, Weibo, ect., which are in actual applications for government, police, army, museum, ect. We are also expertised in ASR, automatic speech recognition with high accuracy, specially for Cantonese, with applications for live report caption, influencer live caption, movie caption, ect, Besides, we also have OCR algorithm to recognise characters, numbers from video/image.



With about 20 years of development and experience, E-Song has become an expert to bring your product ideas or demand to an actual product or a complete solution.

jobInfo.address: 深圳福田区新天世纪商务中心A座801
jobInfo.postDescription:
岗位职责
1、依产品规格，制定测试计划，设计全面测试用例，覆盖功能、性能、兼容性等。
2、执行硬件功能测试，如图像采集、视频编码等，记录缺陷。
3、开展性能测试，评估续航、发热、数据处理速度，提供优化数据。
4、进行兼容性测试，确保产品与不同系统、应用、网络协同稳定。
5、搭建并维护测试环境。
6、分析测试结果，撰写报告，与研发沟通解决问题。
7、跟踪产品迭代，做回归测试。

任职要求
1、本科及以上，电子信息、计算机等相关专业，2 年以上智能硬件测试经验，有穿戴或物联网产品测试经验优先。
2、熟悉测试流程与方法，能熟练编写测试用例。
3、掌握示波器等硬件测试工具，会排查故障、分析性能。
4、熟悉常见通信协议，能进行网络测试。
5、问题分析解决能力强。
6、工作负责，注重细节，团队协作与沟通良好。
7、对新技术学习热情高，适应能力强。
